description: This Dart source file defines the NoteProvider class, which manages the state and CRUD operations for notes within a Flutter application. It interacts with a database service to load, add, update, and delete notes, and provides filtering capabilities based on search queries and categories.

classes.name: NoteProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that provides CRUD operations and state management for notes, facilitating communication between the database layer and UI components.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from the database and updates the internal list, notifying listeners.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database, updates the local list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database, modifies the local list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note from the database, updates the local list, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of notes based on optional search query and category.
